method: Unprompted English transcription from the decoded 16 kHz mono final MP3, independent segments, greedy deterministic decoding; word alignment lowercases and removes punctuation. Interpret recognized differences by line. A recognition result cannot establish a human listener’s judgment.

lines.caption: Write what you saw under Evidence. Put what you think it means under Hypotheses.
lines.transcript: Write what you saw under evidence. Put what you think it means under hypotheses.

lines.caption: Copper, fiber and radio can each offer a valid route here. Choose one, then prove that your choice meets its stated conditions.
lines.transcript: Copper, fiber, and radio can each offer a valid route here. Choose one, then prove that your choice meets its stated conditions.

lines.caption: An ally can help you inspect or change the declared system. A conventional tool can still solve a required repair.
lines.transcript: An ally can help you inspect or change the declared system. A conventional tool can still solve a required repair.

lines.caption: You may bring two active allies. Change your team at a safe place; preparation is part of engineering.
lines.transcript: You may bring two active allies. Change your team at a safe place. Preparation is part of engineering.

lines.caption: A physical link can work while an application fails. Name exactly what your test establishes.
lines.transcript: A physical link can work while an application fails. Name exactly what your test establishes.

lines.caption: A hint is another tool. We record its use so the story is honest, not so the ending can scold you.
lines.transcript: A hint is another tool. We record its use so the story is honest, not so the ending can scold you.

lines.caption: Changing the path changes the question. An earlier passing measurement cannot validate the new configuration.
lines.transcript: Changing the path changes the question. An earlier passing measurement cannot validate the new configuration.

lines.caption: A useful wrong hypothesis is one the evidence has helped you retire. Put the next one on the board.
lines.transcript: A useful, wrong hypothesis is one the evidence has helped you retire. Put the next one on the board.

lines.caption: A malformed challenge is our authoring problem. It is not a mistake you should be punished for.
lines.transcript: A malformed challenge is our authoring problem. It is not a mistake you should be punished for.

lines.caption: Before committing at the Rift, review your route, its limits and your way back to preparation.
lines.transcript: Before committing at the rift, review your route, its limits, and your way back to preparation.

lines.caption: Repeat the link measurements and the declared endpoint test. Arrival at the balcony is not evidence of recovery.
lines.transcript: Repeat the link measurements and the declared end point test. Arrival at the balcony is not evidence of recovery.

lines.caption: A permanent repair needs a maintenance plan, too. The next apprentice deserves a useful record.
lines.transcript: A permanent repair needs a maintenance plan, too. The next apprentice deserves a useful record.

lines.caption: A temporary bridge can be a sound decision. Say what it depends on, and say when the lasting repair is due.
lines.transcript: A temporary bridge can be a sound decision. Say what it depends on and say when the lasting repair is due.

lines.caption: You chose to isolate an unresolved fault safely. Continue when you are ready to return to preparation.
lines.transcript: You chose to isolate and unresolved fault safely. Continue when you are ready to return to preparation.

lines.caption: I am Photon. I carry light and an unreasonable amount of optimism. Shall we inspect that dark link lamp?
lines.transcript: I am Photon. I carry light and an unreasonable amount of optimism. Shall we inspect that dark link lamp?

lines.caption: The power lamp is cheerful. The link lamp has declined to comment. We should record both.
lines.transcript: The power lamp is cheerful. The link lamp has declined to comment. We should record both.

lines.caption: Your notebook keeps clues you have found. You do not have to remember every word I say.
lines.transcript: Your notebook keeps clues you have found. You do not have to remember every word I say.

lines.caption: Compare the recovered bits with the known lab pattern. That comparison is not a universal error detector built into every physical link.
lines.transcript: Compare the recovered bits with the known lab pattern. That comparison is not a universal error detector built into every physical link.

lines.caption: Start with the connector inspection. A dramatic theory can wait while we look for an ordinary defect.
lines.transcript: Start with the connector inspection. A dramatic theory can wait while we look for an ordinary defect.

lines.caption: Use the inspection equipment. Never look directly into a live optical port or fiber end.
lines.transcript: Use the inspection equipment. Never look directly into a live optical port or fiber end.
